verdict.rationale: Google docs cover removing a lost key from an account (google-titan-docs-9) and enrolling a security key (google-titan-docs-15), and a community comment notes Google's own guidance to keep one key in daily use and store a backup safely (google-titan-comm-3), implying an informal backup-key strategy. However there is no first-party documentation laying out a full lockout-recovery plan (e.g., how to regain account access before removing the key, what happens if the only registered key is lost, or explicit backup-key enrollment steps). missing for 10: explicit vendor doc on account lockout scenarios, dedicated backup-key enrollment walkthrough, and clarity on what is/isn't recoverable if the sole key is lost
